## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the principles of openCalory (adherence-neutral design, offline-first reliability).
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally across responsive viewports (Mobile and Desktop).
- [ ] I have added or updated unit/integration tests (`npm test` passes).
- [ ] Linting checks pass (`npm run lint`).
- [ ] The production build succeeds (`npm run build`).
- [ ] No secrets, private API keys, or personal tokens are committed.
